subject: general
question: Choose the antonym of 'eloquent':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Inexpressive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"eloquent"** means fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing; having the ability to express oneself clearly and effectively. (प्रभावशाली और स्पष्ट भाषण करने वाला)

 
 
• **Example: **The politician’s eloquent speech captivated the audience and inspired them to take action.
 
 
 
• **"Inexpressive"** refers to someone or something that lacks the ability to clearly express thoughts, feelings, or emotions; devoid of expression. (अस्पष्ट या भावनाहीन)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the exciting news, his face remained inexpressive, showing no emotion.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'eloquent'** is **'inexpressive'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Inexpressive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Articulate **(स्पष्ट और प्रभावी रूप से बोलने वाला): Having the ability to express oneself fluently and coherently.

 
 
• **Example:** She is an articulate speaker who conveys her ideas with clarity and precision.
 
 
 
• **Fluent **(धाराप्रवाह): Able to speak or write smoothly and effortlessly.
 
 
• **Example: ** After years of practice, he became fluent in French.
 
 
 
• **Persuasive** (प्रभावशाली): Able to convince others effectively through reasoning or argument.
 
 
• **Example:** Her persuasive arguments convinced the jury to support her client’s case.
 
 

171:Ta72,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
